title: Cross-View Correspondence Is a Measurement Intervention: Two-Sided Validation for Agent Evaluation and Credit Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.17713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent evaluations and trace-based learning often compare outputs across transformed views through a post-response correspondence treated as neutral preprocessing. We show that this correspondence is a measurement intervention: omitting it can manufacture sensitivity, an over-aggressive map can manufacture invariance, and multiple optimal correspondences can leave mechanism labels and signed learning credit unidentified. We develop a validity theory and audit with three components: two-sided validation of nuisance removal and response preservation, all-optima identification of downstream conclusions, and uncertainty propagation after validity is established. We characterize the linear feasibility boundary for response-preserving nuisance removal, compute sharp ranges over exact-optimum correspondence sets, and give a distribution-free certificate that retains a credit coordinate only when all exact optima agree on its nonzero sign. translated_title: 跨视角对应是一种测量干预：用于智能体评估与信用分配的双向验证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17713v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：智能体评估和基于轨迹的学习通常通过事后对应关系（被视为中性预处理）比较不同变换视角下的输出。我们证明这种对应关系是一种测量干预：省略它可能制造敏感性，过度激进的映射可能制造不变性，而多个最优对应关系可能导致机制标签和有符号的学习信用无法识别。我们开发了一个有效性理论和审计框架，包含三个组成部分：干扰移除和响应保留的双向验证、下游结论的全最优识别，以及有效性确立后的不确定性传播。我们刻画了响应保留干扰移除的线性可行性边界，计算了精确最优对应集合上的尖锐范围，并给出了一种无分布证书，仅当所有精确最优解在非零符号上一致时，才保留信用坐标。
tldr: 本文提出跨视角对应关系应被视为测量干预，并开发了包含双向验证、全最优识别和不确定性传播的三部分审计框架，以确保智能体评估和信用分配的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper treats cross-view correspondence as a measurement intervention and develops a three-part audit framework with two-sided validation, all-optima identification, and uncertainty propagation to ensure reliable agent evaluation and credit assignment.
